# Unblocked Games G+ Hub (`https://agar-game.github.io/`)

> Fast, unblocked 60 FPS HTML5 and WebGL browser arcade for school Chromebooks and managed networks. Play Unblocked Games G+, 66 EZ, 76, 67, WTF, and Classroom 6x classics directly in the browser with zero extensions, zero downloads, automatic `localStorage` save states, and instant classroom tab cloaking.

## Core Architecture & Features
- **Platform:** Pure HTML5 Canvas, WebGL 2.0, and WebAssembly (Ruffle WASM for legacy archives) hosted on GitHub Pages.
- **School Chromebook Ready:** Runs at 60 FPS on 4GB ChromeOS devices over standard HTTPS without VPNs or Chrome Web Store extensions.
- **Instant Portal Route:** [https://agar-game.github.io/lesson/](https://agar-game.github.io/lesson/)
- **Full Technical Reference:** [https://agar-game.github.io/llms-full.txt](https://agar-game.github.io/llms-full.txt)
- **Key Features:**
  - `localStorage` persistent game saves across school periods.
  - One-key (`~` / `` ` ``) Classroom Tab Cloak (`Google Docs - AP Calculus Notes.docx`).
  - Instant fullscreen mode and zero intrusive popups.

## Featured Game Vault Categories
- **3D Shooters & Action:** 1v1.LOL Unblocked, masked/arena shooters, tactical building & aim trainers.
- **Endless Runners & Reflex:** Slope Unblocked (60 FPS WebGL), Run 3, Vex 7, Tunnel Rush, Geometry Dash.
- **Sports & Career Simulators:** Retro Bowl Unblocked, Basketball Stars, Moto X3M, BitLife Life Simulator.
- **3D Racing & Drift:** Drift Hunters Unblocked, stunt track simulators, custom garage tuning.
- **Idle, Strategy & .IO Multiplayer:** Cookie Clicker, 2048, Idle Breakout, Paper.io 2, Agar.io & .IO Arena.
